About.title: About
About.bio: I'm a product designer focused on complex B2B and enterprise ecosystems. For over 9 years, I've been turning data-heavy products — from IDEs to risk management systems — into intuitive interfaces. I combine deep UX research with an engineering mindset and AI technologies. I build effective design processes and help teams grow.
